name: Stock Replenishment Report
purpose: Flags items that need reordering in each warehouse, day by day

inputs.snapshot_date: Date the stock figures are for
inputs.closing_stock: Quantity in the warehouse at the end of the day
inputs.qty_received: Quantity that came into the warehouse that day
inputs.qty_issued: Quantity that left the warehouse that day
inputs.reorder_level: Stock level at which a new order should be placed
inputs.last_count_time: Date and time the item was last physically counted
inputs.counted_by: Name of the person who did the last physical count
inputs.unit_of_measure: Unit the quantities are counted in, e.g. pieces, kg or cartons
